The house

Whitewashed Cycladic lines, a terrace built for sunsets, and the Aegean at the end of the garden.

Aegean House sits above Agios Lazaros with an uninterrupted view west. The architecture is classic Mykonos — thick white walls, rounded edges, shaded courtyards — with interiors kept deliberately quiet.

Six bedrooms, a large pool and a terrace that takes the sunset seriously. The town is fifteen minutes away; the beach clubs are closer.
